questions.stem: A 51-year-old male presented to the emergency with a history of chest pain for the last 3 hours. The pain is radiating to the jaw and left arm ECG shows ST elevation in leads 2, 3 avF, and V5, V6. Trop I is elevated. Cardiac auscultation reveals a decrescendo early systolic murmur heard at the apex. What is the most common valvular lesion complicating this condition?
